items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: And through talking with, with guys, with Lori and all them guys, the lady he is, Ed Carlton, all the musicians that we played with.

ctx.x: The reason I asked about Lil is because, uh, I've read a lot of books about him, and I kind of get the impression that she, uh, had a very strong influence. Well, she did. As a musician. She did. Lil was a fine musician herself.

And through talking with, with guys, with Lori and all them guys, the lady he is, Ed Carlton, all the musicians that we played with. She did. As a matter of fact, Lil was one of the ones that told Lil that he should go on his own.
Mm-hmm. And break with Papa Joe? And break with Papa Joe?
